task_description: Implement IAM permissions snapshot testing for CDK CLI integration tests - capturing IAM roles assumed and actions performed during test execution, with snapshot comparison to detect permission changes

features.description: Create AWS SDK permissions interceptor module for tracking IAM actions and role assumptions
steps: Create new directory `packages/@aws-cdk/integ-tests-alpha/lib/permissions/` for permissions tracking module
Implement `PermissionsTracker` class with AWS SDK v3 middleware support to intercept all SDK calls
Add tracking for STS AssumeRole, AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, AssumeRoleWithSAML operations to capture role assumptions
Implement IAM action extraction from SDK calls (convert service/operation to service:action format)
Create `PermissionsSnapshot` interface to define the snapshot data structure with rolesAssumed and actionsPerformed arrays
Add support for organizing permissions by test case name
Write unit tests for PermissionsTracker class with mocked AWS SDK calls
acceptance_criteria: PermissionsTracker can be attached to AWS SDK clients as middleware
All STS role assumption calls are captured with role ARN
All AWS service calls are captured in service:action format (e.g., s3:PutObject)
Permissions are organized by test case identifier
Unit tests cover middleware interception, role tracking, and action extraction

features.description: Implement permissions snapshot writer and reader with comparison logic
steps: Create `PermissionsSnapshotWriter` class in `packages/@aws-cdk/integ-tests-alpha/lib/permissions/snapshot-writer.ts`
Implement write functionality to save `permissions.snapshot.json` to snapshot directories
Create `PermissionsSnapshotReader` class to read existing snapshot files
Implement `PermissionsSnapshotComparator` class with diff logic to compare two snapshots
Add support for detecting added/removed roles and added/removed actions
Generate human-readable diff output for failed comparisons
Follow existing pattern from `IntegManifestWriter` for file handling
Write unit tests for snapshot read/write and comparison logic
acceptance_criteria: Snapshots are written in sorted, deterministic JSON format for stable diffs
Reader correctly parses existing permission snapshot files
Comparator detects differences in roles assumed
Comparator detects differences in IAM actions performed
Comparison output clearly shows what changed (added/removed items)
Unit tests cover write, read, and comparison scenarios

features.description: Integrate permissions tracking with IntegTest framework and manifest synthesizer
steps: Add `enablePermissionsSnapshot` option to `IntegTestProps` in `test-case.ts`
Modify `IntegManifestSynthesizer` to include permissions tracking configuration in manifest
Update `IntegTestCase` to support permissions snapshot metadata
Add permissions snapshot file path to cloud assembly schema if needed
Export new permissions tracking classes from `packages/@aws-cdk/integ-tests-alpha/lib/index.ts`
Update README.md with documentation for the new permissions snapshot feature
Write integration tests demonstrating the permissions snapshot functionality
acceptance_criteria: IntegTest accepts `enablePermissionsSnapshot` configuration option
Manifest includes permissions tracking settings when enabled
Permissions snapshot configuration is properly synthesized
New classes are exported from the package's public API
Documentation explains how to use permissions snapshots

features.description: Integrate permissions snapshot validation with integration test runner
steps: Modify `tools/@aws-cdk/integration-test-deployment/lib/integration-test-runner.ts` to support permissions tracking
Wrap AWS SDK client creation with PermissionsTracker middleware during test execution
Capture permissions during `cdk deploy` and `cdk destroy` operations
After test execution, write permissions snapshot to test's snapshot directory
Implement comparison between new and existing permissions snapshots
Fail test execution if permissions snapshot differs from stored snapshot (when not in update mode)
Add `--update-permissions-snapshot` flag support for updating snapshots
Add logging to show permissions diff when test fails due to permission changes
Write unit tests for runner integration
acceptance_criteria: Test runner captures all AWS SDK calls made during cdk deploy/destroy
Permissions snapshot is written to `*.snapshot/permissions.snapshot.json`
Test fails with clear error message when permissions change unexpectedly
Users can update permissions snapshots with update flag
Permission diffs are logged in human-readable format
Unit tests verify runner behavior with mocked executions
